name: Stonewatch Keep
summary: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch Keep in eastern Redridge Mountains, turning it against Lakeshire. The Kingdom of Stormwind built and manned the fortress before the invaders seized it as a base for their warlords.

sections.title: A Fallen Bastion
sections.body: Stonewatch Keep once guarded the eastern ridges and the settlers of Lakeshire from hostile incursions. That changed when the renegade warlock Morganth allied with the Blackrock clan. Strengthened by dark magic, the orcs stormed the fortress and overcame its human defenders. After their victory, Morganth abandoned the Blackrock clan to raise the nearby Tower of Ilgalar and subjugate local gnolls. The invaders kept Stonewatch, turning a former Alliance bastion into a staging ground for assaults on the valley.

sections.title: The Warlord's Seat
sections.body: A heavy garrison of Blackrock warriors holds Stonewatch Keep under the command of the orc warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. From the ramparts, they direct raids across Redridge and take prisoners, including Stormwind's Corporal Keeshan. Stormwind's forces are spread thin, leaving the kingdom unable to send a full regiment to reclaim the fortress. Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have hired mercenary champions to enter the stronghold and kill the Blackrock leaders before Lakeshire is overrun.

faq.q: Who owns Stonewatch Keep right now?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan holds Stonewatch Keep under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and his lieutenant, Tharil'zun. The fortress once belonged to the Alliance and protected Lakeshire before its capture.

faq.q: How did the Blackrock orcs capture the keep?
faq.answer: Morganth, a renegade human warlock, allied with the Blackrock clan. His dark magic strengthened the orcs as they stormed Stonewatch and overwhelmed its human defenders.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Stormwind Army retake Stonewatch Keep?
faq.answer: Internal politics and troop shortages across the kingdom have left Redridge largely neglected by Stormwind's army. Lakeshire's leaders must rely on independent adventurers to face the threat.

faq.q: What is Morganth's connection to this fortress?
faq.answer: Morganth helped the Blackrock clan capture Stonewatch Keep, then abandoned them after their victory. He went to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar, where he raised his lair and used ensorcelled Shadowhide gnolls to do his bidding.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Stonewatch Keep recalls Stormwind's strained borders. Its ramparts must be cleared to protect Lakeshire's vulnerable townsfolk.
As a human, you can honor the defenders who shed blood at Stonewatch by helping free the keep and avenge the soldiers and captives taken by the Blackrock clan.
